### What it Means to Have Faith that Can Move Mountains
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/faith-can-move-mountains-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Matthew 17:20
Points:
- Jesus uses the tiny mustard seed to demonstrate that even small, genuine faith holds tremendous power.
- Mountains symbolize overwhelming challenges and obstacles in life, such as illness, financial distress, and spiritual conflict.
- The focus of faith is resting in God's unlimited strength rather than relying on our own adequacy.
- Faith expands as believers root themselves in Scripture and cultivate trust through prayer and obedience.

### All We Will Get in 2002 Is Mercy
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/all-we-will-get-in-2002-is-mercy
Passage: Luke 17:5-10
Points:
- Faith accomplishes the impossible not because of human willpower, but because God provides the power.
- Even the smallest seed of true faith successfully connects believers to Christ's almighty help.
- Complete obedience to God's commands never places Him in our debt or earns special standing.
- Disciples always remain unworthy servants whose only claim is dependence on God's unmerited mercy.
